_comment: Devin Stop hook for loops-android. Place this under the 'hooks' key in your Devin user config (%APPDATA%\devin\config.json on Windows, ~/.config/devin/config.json elsewhere) or in a project's .devin/hooks.v1.json. It blocks the agent from stopping while .agents/state/loops-android.active exists. Coexists safely with other loop stop hooks because each only checks its own marker file.

hooks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const marker='.agents/state/loops-android.active'; if(fs.existsSync(marker)) console.log(JSON.stringify({decision:'block',reason:'loops-android validation loop is active. Validate the change before stopping, or delete .agents/state/loops-android.active to bypass.'}));"
